name: {{code}}_curate_pool
description: Declarative, tracked curation of the exemplar pool: raw pool -> rules file -> NEW versioned CSV (the raw pool is never edited; each variant gets its own retrieval index, and embedding vectors are reused across versions so re-curation costs minutes). Add rules as failure modes surface: non-clinical rows, export artifacts, pairs teaching superseded forms. Prefer drop over rewrite for reference data. After a run, register the output CSV as a source and repoint translate flows at it explicitly — an A/B is a flow edit.
